description:
Sian, a witch hiding her past, lives in secrecy in a small forest on the outskirts of a rural village. One day, the witch hunter Pedric appears before her. When her identity is exposed, and death seems inevitable, Pedric offers a strange proposal in exchange for her life: to be with him and become human. 

As her magic is slowly stripped away with every touch—replaced by an unfamiliar warmth—Sian begins to dream of a future as an ordinary human by his side. But the shadows of her past gradually tighten around them both.

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13697533), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1746033772), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/witch_hunt), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/witch_hunt), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000077522)
